_help.hexFill: Colour of an empty garden hex.
_help.moveGlow: Highlight on hexes a glyphling can move to.
_help.castGlow: Highlight on hexes a seed can be cast to.
_help.glowStrength: How strong the highlights are. 0 = invisible, 1 = solid.
_help.pieceScale: Size of seeds and glyphlings inside their hex. 1 = fills the hex.
_help.ghostOpacity: How visible the faded glyphling left where it started (tap it to send the glyphling back).
_help.yellow: Yellow player's colour — used for their 'held' and 'planned' rings and their thrown seed.
_help.blue: Blue player's colour — same uses as yellow.
_help.plannedSeedLook: How a targeted (not yet thrown) seed looks — always solid, nothing shows through it: moonlit (default) = colourless moonlight-silver, a ghost of the seed, letter bright · stencil = a flat pale cut-out of the letter and border · misty = under a pale wash (letter hard to read) · greyed = grey and darker · dimmed = faded over a patch of hex colour.
_help.plannedMoonLight: "moonlit" look: the colour the BRIGHT parts (the letter, the border) turn.
_help.plannedMoonShadow: "moonlit" look: the colour the DARK parts (the tile behind the letter) turn. Keep it dark so the letter stands out.
_help.plannedMoonBrightness: "moonlit" look: lifts the letter towards plannedMoonLight. 1 = as bright as the seed, higher = brighter letter (and a lighter tile).
_help.plannedStencilLetter: "stencil" look: the colour of the letter and border.
_help.plannedStencilTile: "stencil" look: the colour of the plain tile behind the letter.
_help.plannedStencilCut: "stencil" look: how bright a part of the seed must be to count as letter. Lower = more of the picture (sparkles, vines) turns to letter.
_help.plannedStencilSoftness: "stencil" look: how soft the letter's edge is. Small = crisp but jagged, big = smooth but blurry.
_help.plannedMist: "misty" look: the colour of the pale wash over a targeted seed.
_help.plannedMistStrength: "misty" look: how thick the wash is. 0 = none (looks planted), 1 = the seed is hidden.
_help.plannedSeedOpacity: "dimmed" look only: how strong the targeted seed's picture is over its hex-coloured patch. 1 = full colour.
_help.purple: Purple player colour — same uses as yellow.
_help.pink: Pink player colour — same uses as yellow.
_help.wordBorder: Colour of the border round a made word — neutral (never a player colour).
_help.wordBorderWidth: Thickness of the white border round a made word (planned while aiming, and just after it grows), in hex sizes. It sits BEHIND the seeds, so only the part outside the letters shows. Word indicators on only.
_help.grownGlowStrength: How strong the word border is on the words that just grew (1 = as strong as while aiming). They stay outlined, one word at a time, until play moves on. 0 = none.
_help.spotlightLabel: Word spotlight: show the lit word and its Magic as a small label ("QUA +4") next to it, on a free spot that covers no letters. Off = just the white border.
_help.spotlightLabelSize: Size of the word spotlight label text, in hex sizes.
_help.spotlightLabelMinPx: The smallest the word spotlight label may be on screen, in pixels (small boards on phones would make it tiny).
_help.seedShine: The little highlight on a seed flying through the air.
_help.warningWidth: Thickness of the dashed "thorny" ring round a glyphling with only ONE move left, in hex sizes. Drawn in its owner's colour.
_help.warningDash: Length of each dash in that ring, in hex sizes (the gaps are a little shorter).
_help.vine: Colour of the vine that wraps a TANGLED glyphling (no moves left).
_help.vineWidth: Thickness of that vine, in hex sizes.
_help.tangledDim: How faded a tangled glyphling looks under its vine. 1 = not faded.
_help.revealPop: Colour of the "+3" tangle bonuses that pop up at the end.
_help.revealPopSize: Size of the "+3" text, in hex sizes.
_help.scorePop: Colour of the score pops ("+1", "+2" over each seed of a made word, and the turn's total).
_help.scorePopSize: Size of each seed's "+1" / "+2", in hex sizes.
_help.scoreTotalSize: Size of the turn's total ("+6") over the glyphling that cast, in hex sizes.
_help.dropStrength: While dragging a piece: how strong the "drop here" highlight is on the legal hex under it (brighter than the other options). 1 = solid.
_help.scorePopMinPx: The smallest a seed's "+1" / "+2" may be on screen, in pixels (small boards on phones would make it tiny). The total is drawn this much bigger too, relative to scoreTotalSize ÷ scorePopSize.
